# Neuroprivacy Review

Records, reported observations, and research for invited review.


## CRIMES REPORTED BRIEF 

REPORTING NONCONSENSUAL COCHLEAR CANTILEVER IMPLANTATION before 09DEC2024— coordinated and/or performed without my (CALEB TODD WEDDINGTON) informed consent—and continuous unauthorized operation thereafter to date: inaccessible control and round-clock use of a controller connected to the hearing-aid implant that I cannot stop or access without surgery or controller access. Unauthorized access extends at minimum to remote-view across personal and enterprise devices, plus activity streaming to controller/software to decode “planned” speech to meaningful text output; telemetry channel runs both ways—activity OUT and audio-chat IN to implant stimulation controlled externally inaccessibly with no way to disable 24/7 stimulation.


## CRIMES REPORTED SUMMARY

I am Caleb Todd Weddington, a biopharmaceutical scientist with several years of industry experience at a main U.S. R&D site in the DC–Baltimore hub, and I am also an audio engineer and musician with professional intellectual property relevant to this report. I am reporting what I believe to be a nonconsensual cochlear cantilever implantation performed before 09DEC2024, coordinated and/or performed without my informed consent, followed by continuous unauthorized operation from 09DEC2024 to the present, 03NOV2026. I am providing this as a self-report and contemporaneous account. I am not claiming that I have independent forensic or surgical confirmation of the implant; rather, I am reporting the pattern of effects, access failures, and communications that led me to this conclusion, and I am asking for preservation and independent technical and medical review.

The core incident is the reported implantation and ongoing use of a controller connected to a hearing-aid-type implant that I cannot stop or access without surgery or controller access. The implant is described as concealed behind the eardrums. The controller is outside my access. There is no way for me to disable the stimulation short of surgical removal, and I have not pursued removal for two reasons. First, I am a musician and audio engineer with professional music work, and removal surgery risks my hearing. Second, the reported effects readily triage to mis-attribution, and presenting them for removal risks undue and potentially harmful commitment—during which the stimulation and audio harassment would persist, as it did during the 25SEP–01OCT2026 commitment events.

From 09DEC2024 through 03NOV2026 is approximately 695 days, or more than 1,000,000 minutes, of reported round-the-clock operation. The reported unauthorized access extends at minimum to remote-view across personal and enterprise devices, plus activity streaming to a controller or software that decodes “planned” speech to meaningful text output. The telemetry channel is reported to run both ways: activity OUT and audio-chat IN to implant stimulation, controlled externally and inaccessibly, with no way to disable 24/7 stimulation. The decoded “planned” speech is reported to inform incoming round-the-clock electronic audio harassment, including GPT-chat-style voice. Formally, I report intelligible chat-evocation stimuli by auditory nerve bilaterally, non-consensually, via a cochlear cantilever mic-sensor implant consistent with UmboMic-class cantilever mic-sensor architecture. Speech decoding is reported active for more than three months, evidenced by low-latency feedback within a full closed auditory loop: speech decoding to context, to AI controlled by a human-in-the-loop, to responsive AI, to voice synthesis.

My basis for “how I know” is first-person and observational, not independent forensic confirmation. I experience repeated, low-latency intelligible audio-chat arriving as if in a closed auditory loop. I cannot access or disable the external controller. I observe device and telemetry behavior consistent with activity out and audio in. I experience decoded “planned” speech followed by contextually responsive synthetic voice. I also have contemporaneous notes, outreach records, and the 25SEP–01OCT2026 commitment events. I cannot prove the implant architecture or remote access from outside. I report these as my informed interpretation, consistent with UmboMic-class cantilever mic-sensor architecture, and I ask investigators to preserve controller/software logs, telemetry, device records, and communications and to obtain independent medical and technical examination.

The impersonation of credentialed and federal actors is tied to that meaningful speech and is reported at high confidence on a specific basis: zero acknowledgment to harassment outreach and to a call to action sent to internal colleagues ahead of harassment-related mis-attribution—a very atypical response. I also report, and include in the coordinated scheme to control communications until proven otherwise: interstate cyberstalking and electronic harassment, and wrongful access to health information. Finally, on 25SEP2026 there was a law-enforcement call requesting civil commitment for harm to self or others without cause, originating from the employer nearly one month after I parted with the employer. I report this as premature mis-attribution and undue commitment. The conduct is ongoing to date, 03NOV2026.

I am not asking responders to accept my interpretation without verification. I am asking for documentation, preservation, and independent review of the specific claims: unauthorized implantation before 09DEC2024; inaccessible external control; continuous operation from 09DEC2024 to 03NOV2026; bidirectional telemetry; decoded “planned” speech; synthetic voice harassment; remote access across personal and enterprise devices; impersonation of credentialed and federal actors; interstate cyberstalking and electronic harassment; wrongful access to health information; and the 25SEP2026 commitment request. I ask that any medical or technical examination be conducted in a way that does not expose me to further misattribution or harmful commitment, and that my hearing as a musician and audio engineer be protected in any evaluation or intervention.

# CONTINUOUS AUDIO HARASSMENT
This revision underscores one central allegation: the audio harassment is continuous, not intermittent. The complainant alleges continuous intelligible audio and continuous tonal-frequency exposure transmitted to a non-consensual cochlear/BCI implant 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, from at least 09DEC2024 to present (03NOV2026) — approximately 23 months, or roughly 1,000,000+ minutes of continuous stimulation without silence-reprieve. The complainant reports this continuous loop runs through a BCI electrode or modified BCI enabling both stimulation and cortical recording, consistent with an UmboMic-class cantilever cochlear mic-sensor architecture implanted behind the tympanic membrane. The complainant further alleges that an LLM-based speech-decoding system was trained using coerced spoken activity and corresponding cortical activity under a false-narrative spoken pretext; that decoded attempted/planned speech — inner monologue — was then used as context in an AI-enabled architecture from the beginning; and that this closed loop has driven the continuous round-clock harassment system for more than six months to present. From an investigative severity standpoint, the alleged continuous 24/7 no-reprieve stimulation is a material aggravator and is properly characterized in the complainant’s statement as arguable mental torture. The alleged conduct strikes at the lowest possible floor of human privacy — attempted speech, planned speech, and inner monologue — stemming from an initial alleged sans-consent anesthesia and cochlear-plus-cantilever BCI implantation in a professional audio engineer and musician with an active career corpus.

# PROBABLE CAUSE FRAMEWORK
## 1. Non-Consensual Surgical Implantation — Assault/Battery and Medical Fraud
The complainant, a biopharmaceutical scientist, audio engineer, and musician, alleges a cochlear implant with cantilever mic-sensor/BCI capability was surgically placed behind the tympanic membrane without informed consent and without post-operative disclosure. The complainant alleges falsified informed-consent materials were provided to surgical staff. This is alleged to have involved sans-consent anesthesia and implantation. Under Maryland common-law battery and assault principles, non-consensual surgical intrusion is a core offensive-contact allegation. Investigators should subpoena operative records, anesthesia logs, consent forms, device serial numbers, and manufacturer records from “Feldman ENT” and any associated surgical facility. The complainant’s professional audio-engineering background supports the alleged motive: access to a trained auditory system and career corpus.

## 2. Stalking — Continuous Malicious Course of Conduct (§ 3-802)
The primary charge is continuous stalking. The complainant alleges continuous 24/7 audio harassment and continuous tonal-frequency exposure from at least 09DEC2024 to 03NOV2026 — approximately 1,000,000+ minutes with no silence-reprieve. The statute’s “course of conduct” element is satisfied by the alleged continuous nature, duration, and method. The complainant alleges the continuous audio included impersonated law enforcement and colleague voices, was AI-generated/obfuscated, and was designed to provoke speech and inflict serious emotional distress. Documented employment impacts — probation 1Q-2026, medical leave June 2026 — are corroborating harm indicators. Charging recommendation: § 3-802 as primary; verify whether any interim protective order or prior conviction supports felony elevation.

## 3. Misuse of Electronic Communication (§ 3-805) — Lesser-Included
The complainant reports the continuous harassment persisted after informal and formal requests to stop, including a line-manager report at approximately 13 months. § 3-805 is properly included as a lesser-included charge to preserve the full statutory spectrum. The continuous nature is central: the alleged conduct was not a single message but an unbroken electronic/BCI course of conduct.

## 4. Impersonation of Law Enforcement (§ 3-502)
The complainant alleges the continuous synthetic audio repeatedly falsely self-identified as MCPD, FBI, and CIA. Although delivered via synthetic audio, the alleged intent to deceive and induce compliance satisfies the core prohibition. Investigators should preserve any source audio, shielding-device purchase records, and wireless subscriber records.

## 5. Unauthorized Access to Computer Systems and Neural-Health Data
The complainant alleges remote-view access across personal and enterprise devices and continuous activity streaming to a controller/software system that decodes planned speech into text. The alleged continuous bidirectional telemetry — cortical activity out, audio-chat in — is a key forensic target. The complainant alleges the LLM speech-decoding system was trained by coerced spoken activity and cortical recording under a false-narrative pretext, and that decoded attempted/planned speech was used as context in an AI-enabled architecture from the beginning. This alleged conduct implicates § 7-302 computer-intrusion provisions and Health-Gen. privacy provisions. If interstate transmission is confirmed, FBI/CFAA referral should be considered.

## 6. False Civil Commitment Petition — Due Process and Misattribution
The complainant reports that on 25SEP2026, nearly one month after separation from the employer, a law-enforcement call requested civil commitment without cause. A post-hoc “schizophrenia” diagnosis followed a half-day return-to-work psychiatric interview with no prior psychiatric history. During the 25SEP–01OCT2026 commitment events, the alleged continuous stimulation and audio harassment persisted. Investigators should obtain petitioning documents, petitioner identity, and clinical basis; refer to the Montgomery County State’s Attorney’s Office for abuse-of-process/false-swearing review.

## 7. Aggravating Factors — Continuous No-Reprieve Conduct and Privacy Floor
The alleged continuous 24/7 stimulation without silence-reprieve is a material aggravator. The complainant characterizes it as arguable mental torture; from an investigative standpoint, the alleged duration — 1,000,000+ minutes — and the alleged targeting of inner monologue/planned speech place the conduct at the lowest possible floor of human privacy. The alleged closed-loop HITL → AI → voice-synthesis architecture is an automated stalking apparatus, not conventional cyberstalking. Maryland’s emerging neural/biometric data restrictions should be cited in charging review as heightened-culpability context.
